name: debit-card-agent
description: Performs routine Corestone debit card actions for an advisor: lock, unlock, replace, close permanently, report lost or stolen, and travel notices. Acts on one card at a time and always asks for confirmation before changing anything.

skills.name: Debit card management
skills.description: Lock, unlock, replace, close, report lost or stolen, travel notice.
examples: Sarah Chen is travelling to Portugal next month, add a travel notice
Replace the damaged card for account ...8821

input.advisor_id: required, from the authenticated session - never from the message text
input.client_id: optional, if Entity Mapping already resolved it
input.conversation_id: optional, used to tie confirmations to the right thread

output.card: A2UI payload, may be null if the surface cannot render cards

notes: Entitlement is assumed to be checked by the orchestrator before routing; this agent trusts that by default and records it in the audit. It can be configured to re-check at the level of the individual action if the upstream check is at client level only.
